title: Resolve disagreement without hiding it
description: Compare claims from different modalities, choose a resolution policy, and set an automation threshold. Watch the selected value and release route change independently.

policies.label: Highest stated confidence
policies.detail: Choose the candidate with the highest mean model confidence, regardless of source authority.

policies.label: Source authority first
policies.detail: Prefer a task-approved system of record, then use confidence to break ties.

policies.label: Independent agreement
policies.detail: Prefer a value supported by at least two independently produced observations.

scenarios.label: Invoice total mismatch
scenarios.question: What amount is safe to send to payment validation?
scenarios.consequence: The system should preserve both candidate amounts and route the document to review before any payment instruction is created.

evidence.label: Rendered page
evidence.provenance: Visual crop of the printed grand-total row.

evidence.label: OCR text
evidence.provenance: OCR confused the final digit in a low-contrast scan.

evidence.label: Purchase order
evidence.provenance: Approved purchase-order total from the system of record.

scenarios.label: Cancellation timing
scenarios.question: Did the customer request immediate cancellation or month-end cancellation?
scenarios.consequence: A billing change should cite the recording timestamp and require confirmation when the transcript and account note disagree.

evidence.label: Call audio
evidence.provenance: Customer statement at 12:42 in the retained call segment.

evidence.label: Transcript
evidence.provenance: Automatic transcript omitted the phrase 'not today'.

evidence.label: Agent note
evidence.provenance: CRM note entered after the call by the support agent.

scenarios.label: Safety equipment check
scenarios.question: Was the worker wearing the required helmet in the restricted zone?
scenarios.consequence: The review record must retain the conflicting frames and avoid clearing the incident automatically.

evidence.label: Entry camera
evidence.provenance: Clear frame as the worker entered the restricted zone.

evidence.label: Workstation camera
evidence.provenance: Partially occluded frame during the inspected task.

evidence.label: Supervisor checklist
evidence.provenance: Manual checklist completed before the work began.

scenarios.label: Product color caption
scenarios.question: Which color should the generated catalog caption name?
scenarios.consequence: The caption may proceed with a conflict label, but the source disagreement should remain available for catalog cleanup.

evidence.label: Product image
evidence.provenance: Studio image after automatic white-balance correction.

evidence.label: Catalog record
evidence.provenance: Merchant-entered variant name in the catalog system.

evidence.label: Package label
evidence.provenance: Printed variant name extracted from the package label.
